# Chapter 8: The Second Draft

## 2010–2015

---

There is a particular kind of courage required to fall in love when you are no longer young, when your life already contains a full pantry of memories, some sweet and some spoiled. It is not the raw, reckless courage of a twenty-year-old who has nothing to lose. It is the quieter, more considered bravery of someone who has already built a house, watched it weather, and decided—against all sensible caution—to build another one beside it.
